payload.note: The instruments this calibration set was authored against, read from src/eval/metrics.RESEARCH_RUBRICS. No judge has been run against the set and no model is pinned: a grader profile that named a model would be one approval away from a chargeable run, and RFC 11 §9.3 makes selecting a model grader invalid without a recorded cost approval. When a judge is eventually measured, a version here that no longer matches the live rubric is what makes the gate answer HOLD.
